caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest with a rectangular shape, shown in a perspective view. The chest is primarily light to medium brown in color, with darker brown tones highlighting the decorative elements. The front panel features three main rectangular sections, each adorned with detailed, symmetrical carved patterns including circular and floral motifs. Above these sections, there is a horizontal band of intricate, arch-like carvings. Below them, there is a single long horizontal panel divided into three smaller sections with swirling, ornamental designs, each separated by narrow vertical strips. The chest has solid, plain legs at each corner and flat side panels, with all the wood grain and joinery details clearly illustrated. The top of the chest is flat and extends slightly beyond the sides, forming a simple overhanging ledge. The drawing is rendered on a beige or off-white background, emphasizing the focus on the chest itself.
title: Chest with Drawer
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
